name: bugfix
description: Self-contained bug tracking: client+server error capture → BUG_LRS (xAPI verb: failed) + CLI triage
requires: BUG_APP_ID (optional — isolates this app's bugs in a shared LRS; defaults to 'default')
wiring: 1. Client — capture errors at startup (client/src/main.jsx, once):
import { initBugReporter } from './utils/bugReporter';
initBugReporter();   // installs window.error / unhandledrejection / console.error+warn hooks
Manual reports anywhere: import { reportError, reportCaughtError } from './utils/bugReporter';
2. Server — the copied server/services/bugReporter.js is an ADAPTER. In the source app it
re-exports '../../runtime/src/bug/reporter' (the @uals/skill-runtime backbone). Your app
almost certainly has no such module, so pick ONE:
(a) point the adapter's require(...) at YOUR server implementation, or
(b) replace it with an implementation exposing the same 4 fns:
reportError, bugReporterMiddleware, attachProcessHandlers, isConfigured.
The backbone builds an xAPI statement (verb http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/failed), tags it
with BUG_APP_ID, dedups (1-min TTL), and POSTs to BUG_LRS. See README for the exact contract.
3. Server — wire the backbone into Express (server.js):
const { bugReporterMiddleware, attachProcessHandlers } = require('./services/bugReporter');
attachProcessHandlers();          // uncaughtException / unhandledRejection / console capture
// ...after ALL routes are registered:
app.use(bugReporterMiddleware);   // Express error middleware (4-arg) — mount LAST
4. Server — mount the bug-report API (server.js), reusing your auth middleware:
const { createBugReportRoutes } = require('./routes/bugReportRoutes');
app.use('/server/telemetry', createBugReportRoutes({
bugReporter: require('./services/bugReporter'),
optionalAuth, requireAdmin,
→ POST /server/telemetry/bug-report (public)  ·  GET /server/telemetry/bug-reports (admin)
Keep the POST path in sync with the client reporter's ENDPOINT ('/server/telemetry/bug-report').
5. package.json — add triage scripts:
"bugs":      "node scripts/bug-triage.js",
"debugging": "node scripts/bug-triage.js"
6. (Optional) Admin dashboard — add a 'Bug Reports' tab that GETs /server/telemetry/bug-reports
with ?range=7d and renders summary + expandable list (see README / your AdminDashboard).
Reporters no-op SILENTLY when BUG_LRS_* env is absent (local dev). Full spec: this kit's README.md
and @.claude/commands/_shared/BUG_TRACKING_AND_FIXING.md.
